_meta.role: Software Engineer, AI Platform - New Grad

summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from RIT with experience in autonomous systems, GPU computing, and concurrent real-time pipelines. Built AV data annotation pipelines in CARLA, a distributed three-layer robotics platform on NVIDIA Jetson with CUDA-accelerated YOLO, and custom CUDA C++ kernels for 35% inference speedup.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Architected a metal surface inspection data processing pipeline: concurrent image-stitching (custom wavelet bank sym6+bior3.5), wavelet denoising, and monocular depth estimation — PSNR 86 and ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Built a data processing pipeline for BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI (3D volumetric batch-loading, augmentation); trained U-Net with VGG-16/ResNet-50 backbones, evaluated on Dice Score and IoU.
Led a cross-cultural team of 7 as sole ML-experienced member; delivered full ML pipeline within a 6-week window.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT transformer on a custom medical dataset using PyTorch and HuggingFace; improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via domain-specific tokenization.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a distributed three-layer robotics platform (Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, Jetson+Arduino controller via WebSocket) — 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.
Integrated TensorRT YOLO at ~18 FPS and faster-whisper STT (1.0–1.4s) on NVIDIA Jetson; used multiprocessing for concurrent multi-camera capture; implemented two-link IK in C++.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript conv layers with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing and constant memory — 35% speedup over naive GPU (49.2ms vs 73.3ms), 1.5–2× over CPU baseline, identical accuracy.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Deployed YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson for real-time object tracking; relayed control commands to STM32 over UART with interrupt-driven multi-servo PWM and user override.
Coordinated concurrent tasks via FreeRTOS mutexes and shared-memory synchronization; integrated VL53L0X ToF distance sensing with OLED visualization.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Built automated data generation pipelines using CARLA's semantic segmentation and raycast occlusion filtering — ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 UFLD training frames with zero manual annotation.
Trained YOLO11n (mAP50~0.85) and fine-tuned UFLD (ResNet-18) for lane detection; validated full AV stack in Town02 with 30 vehicles — zero collisions, full traffic light compliance.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
